freeze_note: Written during benchmark model loading/warmup after correcting a manifest field-name assertion; no quality results had been inspected and no candidate code was changed.
variant: One-shot physical per-head KVzap pruning after the entire dense 8-bit prefill; retained entries promoted to FP16 for fused decode. All generated tokens retained.
reporting: Report every paired case, all regressions, and paired bootstrap 95% intervals. Point-estimate gates do not prove non-inferiority. No tuning on this validation set.
end_to_end: Measure separately and report all prompt and output lengths. No claim that decode speedup equals whole-request speedup.
capacity: No larger-model claim without a real reproducible workload that a strong unmodified baseline cannot run acceptably.
rejected_online_variant: Quantized online pruning with a protected 2048-token window failed the development quality gate (LCC -27.39 pp); excluded from the candidate.
